parties: Mohammed Sabir Khan (acquirer); Swaraj Suiting Limited
headline: Mohammed Sabir Khan Triggers Substantial Acquisition Disclosure in Swaraj Suiting Limited
sum: Mohammed Sabir Khan has filed a Regulation 31(4) Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) disclosure with NSE, signalling a material stake acquisition in the textile/suiting manufacturer Swaraj Suiting Limited. The filing marks the formal trigger of SEBI takeover code obligations.
implication: A SAST disclosure under Reg 31(4) is filed post-acquisition of 25% or material change in holding; this typically mandates an open offer unless exemptions apply - counsel must track the acquirer's total holding percentage, the timing of the open offer announcement, and any minority protection undertakings or regulatory waivers.
detail: Mohammed Sabir Khan has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, indicating substantial acquisition of shares in Swaraj Suiting Limited (a domestic textile/suiting player). The filing itself does not disclose the precise shareholding acquired, consideration value, or acquisition date in the excerpt; however, Reg 31(4) filings are triggered when an acquirer crosses regulatory thresholds (typically 25% or a material change) or when takeover code obligations crystallize. The NSE filing is the formal public notice required by SEBI and must be followed by open offer or exemption filings within statutory timelines.
